title: AO/414/2012 of UTTAR PRADESH STATE ROAD TRANSPORT CORPORATION Vs SMT. BALVINDRA KAUR and ANR.

paras.text:
MCC No.598 of 2013
In
AO No.414 of 2012
Honíble B.S. Verma, J.
Mr. Abhishek Srivastava, Advocate
holding brief of Mr. Ramji Srivastava,
Advocate for the appellant.
Instant money withdrawal
application has been moved by the
respondent/claimant to withdraw the
amount of Rs.25,000/- deposited by the
appellants before this Court.
This appeal has been finally
decided by this Court on 30.04.2013.
Therefore, Registry is directed to remit
the statutory amount of Rs.25,000/-
deposited by the appellant to the
tribunal concerned, for being withdrawn
by the claimants/respondents.
